data.explanation: This letter from Beispiel Energie AG confirms a new electricity supply contract ("Ökostrom Fix 12") starting 1 January 2026, which they will set up including the switch from your previous supplier. The initial term is 12 months, after which it continues indefinitely and can be cancelled at any time with one month's notice. You'll pay a monthly advance amount (Abschlag) of €78.00, based on a unit price of 31.48 ct/kWh plus a base fee of €12.90/month; the actual usage will be settled later against these advance payments. No action is required now beyond checking that the details (address, meter number, start date) are correct; keep this confirmation for your records and for your annual consumption statement.
